differential.rationale: Long‑standing type 2 diabetes, metabolic syndrome, and proteinuria/microalbuminuria drive CKD progression.

differential.name: Ischemic heart disease (stable angina)
differential.rationale: History of IHD, hypertension, dyslipidemia and reported chest‑related pain score 5 suggest cardiac ischemia.

differential.name: Anemia of chronic disease secondary to CKD
differential.rationale: Chronic kidney disease and documented anemia are common contributors to reduced hemoglobin.

differential.name: Secondary hyperparathyroidism of chronic kidney disease
differential.rationale: Advanced CKD predisposes to altered calcium‑phosphate metabolism despite current normal calcium.
